caption: The drawing features a stylized floral motif as its central object, which consists of a large flower with eight pointed petals alternating in color between a light blue and a muted burgundy tone. The heart of the flower has layers of shapes, with a yellow outline enclosing pink, burgundy, and light blue sections, including an inner detail with a four-pointed star-like design. Below the flower, there is a curving stem that branches out; the left side forms an exaggerated, elongated yellow shape with pink and burgundy outlines that resembles a stylized leaf or flourish, while the right side continues as a curved, tapering burgundy form. At the bottom of the image, there are two geometric, circular decorative elements, one on the left and one on the right, both featuring radial petals in light blue alternating with yellow, and burgundy outlines, with additional internal accents. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: San Juan Capistrano Mission Side Altar from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
